verdict.rationale: SendGrid docs confirm EU regional sending (api.eu.sendgrid.com) as a data-residency option, but this is gated to Pro-plan-or-above subusers and only one alternate region (EU) is documented—no broader region selection (e.g., APAC, custom residency) or details on which data types are covered by regional storage. missing for 10: evidence of additional regions beyond EU, documentation of what data (logs, templates, webhooks) is included in regional residency, and independent/third-party confirmation of residency guarantees.
